entities.name: Water Tribunal of the plain of Valencia
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Water Tribunal of the plain of Valencia, also known as the Tribunal of Waters, is an institution of justice to settle disputes arising from the use of irrigation water by farmers in several Irrigation Communities and canals in the Horta de València. It is the world’s oldest court and the oldest democratic institution in Europe.
